title: GradeEvidence
description: Immutable observed scoring revision accepted from an authorized producer.

offering_id.description: Institution and offering boundary checked against enrollment and grade item.
offering_id.x-reference-scope: Institution and offering boundary checked against enrollment and grade item.

enrollment_id.description: Beneficiary who owns relevant academic enrollment.
enrollment_id.x-reference-scope: Beneficiary who owns relevant academic enrollment.

grade_item_id.description: Approved gradebook line in same offering.
grade_item_id.x-reference-scope: Approved gradebook line in same offering.

source_kind.description: Native, manual, package or external source class.

source_object_id.description: Opaque stable source identity verified against trusted registration.

source_revision.description: Monotonic source revision within evidence tuple.

attempt_ordinal.description: Native candidate attempt number, absent for non-native evidence.

submitted_at.description: Effective native submission time used by the academic lateness policy.

assessment_version_id.description: Native assessment revision pinned at start.
assessment_version_id.x-reference-scope: Native assessment revision pinned at start.

policy_version_id.description: Native delivery policy revision pinned at start.
policy_version_id.x-reference-scope: Native delivery policy revision pinned at start.

late.description: Whether the native submission met the captured published due classification.

status.description: Earned, excused, voided or technical exception.

points.description: Canonical earned points, null for non-earned status.

maximum.description: Canonical positive maximum, null for non-earned status.

mark_revision_ids.description: Exact source mark lineage for native evidence, empty for other sources.
mark_revision_ids.x-reference-scope: Exact source mark lineage for native evidence, empty for other sources.

lineage_digest.description: Source authorization, scoring revision and input lineage fingerprint.

supersedes_id.description: Previous revision for same tuple, null for first.
supersedes_id.x-reference-scope: Previous revision for same tuple, null for first.

approval_reference.description: Verified authorized producer approval for non-native evidence.

enrollment_release_id.description: Native beneficiary release pinned at sitting start, including an individual member of team work.
enrollment_release_id.x-reference-scope: Native beneficiary release pinned at sitting start, including an individual member of team work.

x-invariants: Authorized producers cannot bind unrelated enrollment or grade item.
Native source object ID equals attempt ID.
Earned values must lie in grade item approved range.
Missing is derived by academic policy, not emitted.
Native enrollment_release_id must belong to the beneficiary Enrollment and point to the exact captured individual or team member release.
